office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes in Lincoln County and is the county government's lawyer.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Ty Albertson, appointed in December 2024 from chief deputy prosecutor, is the only candidate in his first election to the office.

candidates.summary: Appointed prosecuting attorney in December 2024 after serving as chief deputy prosecutor handling felony cases; submitted no statement.
highlights: Appointed effective January 2025 to succeed Adam Walser [S3]
Former chief deputy prosecutor who handled all felony cases [S3]
